Title: Register with valid details
Steps: 1. Go to /auth/register 2. Fill all required fields with valid data 3. Submit
Expected Result: Account is created and a success confirmation is shown

Title: Login with newly registered credentials
Steps: 1. Go to /auth/login 2. Enter registered email/password 3. Submit
Expected Result: User is logged in and redirected to account/home; profile shows same first/last name and email

Title: Add multiple products and update quantity in cart
Steps: 1. Add Product A to cart 2. Add Product B to cart 3. Open cart 4. Update quantity of Product A to 2
Expected Result: Cart reflects both products; Product A quantity shows 2 and subtotal updates accordingly

Title: Complete checkout with Cash on Delivery and generate invoice
Preconditions: Cart has at least 1 item; user logged in
Steps: 1. Proceed to checkout 2. Confirm sign-in step 3. Fill billing address 4. Select Cash on Delivery 5. Press Confirm 6. Press Confirm again (known app quirk)
Expected Result: Invoice is generated and appears under My Invoices with a non-empty invoice id/total

Title: Logout ends session
Steps: 1. Open profile 2. Click logout 3. Attempt to open /account/profile again
Expected Result: User is logged out; protected page redirects to login

Title: Login with invalid password is rejected
Steps: 1. Go to login 2. Enter correct email + wrong password 3. Submit
Expected Result: Visible error message shown; user is not logged in; no session created

Title: Registration blocked for an already-used email
Preconditions: User already registered once with a given email
Steps: 1. Attempt to register again using the same email 2. Submit
Test Data: Same email as an existing account
Expected Result: Registration is rejected with a visible duplicate-email error

Title: Search returns relevant products only
Steps: 1. Go to homepage 2. Enter a known product keyword in search 3. Submit
Expected Result: Only products whose name/description matches the keyword are shown
